title: Canonical module extension adjunction for the element projection
statement: Let C be a small site with Grothendieck topology J [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], R a sheaf of rings and A a sheaf of sets in the same universe. Let p:(El(A))^op → C be the element projection, give its source the induced topology, and put R_A=p^*R. On the module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let P be restriction, defined by the continuous pushforward with identity ring map. Define E as Mathlib\'s canonical left adjoint SheafOfModules.pullback for that same site functor and ring map. Then E is left adjoint to P. The element projection, induced topology, restricted ring, fibre presheaf, direct-sum presheaf with its proved restriction laws, and restriction functors are the explicit constructions used in this assertion.

proof.text: The category of elements is small in the sheaf universe. By definition its induced topology makes the projection continuous. Apply Mathlib SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction to this continuous functor and the identity of its restricted ring. Its existence hypotheses follow from the small-site presheaf adjoint and sheafification instances. Package the resulting adjunction as Nonempty. All moved constructions retain their original definitions and proofs.

theorem elementModuleExtension_adjunction
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (R : Sheaf J RingCat.{u}) (A : Sheaf J (Type u)) :
    Nonempty (elementModuleExtension R A ⊣ elementModulePullback R A)
